settings.question: How do I personalize my Christmas gift?
settings.answer: Choose your favorite product, then enter the names or upload the photos requested on its product page. Double-check spelling and your selected options before adding it to your cart.

settings.question: Can I preview my personalized design?
settings.answer: Some products offer a live preview. For products without a live preview, follow the instructions on the product page and carefully check the details you enter.

settings.question: Will my gift arrive before Christmas?
settings.answer: Production and delivery times vary by product and destination. Check the latest estimates on the product page before ordering. A countdown alone does not guarantee a delivery date.

settings.question: What kind of photo should I upload?
settings.answer: Use a clear, well-lit, high-resolution photo. Avoid screenshots, blurry images or photos where important details are cropped out.
